description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS entropy driver for Silicon Labs Gecko series 2 microcontrollers, implementing hardware TRNG functionality with support for different series configurations.

methods.name: entropy_gecko_trng_read
methods.description: Reads random data from the hardware TRNG FIFO into the output buffer.

methods.name: entropy_gecko_trng_get_entropy
methods.description: Retrieves entropy data from the hardware TRNG, filling the provided buffer.

methods.name: entropy_gecko_trng_get_entropy_isr
methods.description: Retrieves entropy data in an interrupt service routine context, with optional busy-wait.

methods.name: entropy_gecko_trng_init
methods.description: Initializes the hardware TRNG, enabling necessary clocks and control registers.
